question: Which exact storage strategy is best for held character artwork and camera motion?
source: Iona and Ren's 17-second Xenomaths shot plan, from the published project's own assets
regimes: camera held at the first pose in each shot

controls.animation: identical actors, pose cues, blink events and shot boundaries

candidates: previous-frame XOR with full bases and hold records
check: Every archive must reproduce every source RGB frame SHA-256 in order. Sample a single-frame restore and reject an intentionally corrupt record. Report encode and restore seconds as one local measurement, not a universal speed.
criteria: For editable source prioritize regenerability and local edit scope. For a ready-to-decode copy prioritize verified exactness, space and standard tooling. For repeated random access also disclose dependence on other frames.
boundary: No alpha/HDR, no 3D noise, 640x360 and one sequence. Compare new content before choosing archive settings for a full episode.
